newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end up on funds shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end up on funds shortage.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates rose on Monday on shortage of funds and dealers said rates may open on Tuesday at similar levels despite an inflow of three billion rupees.
"Conditions remained dry with nominal trading being conducted at the 20 percent mark," a dealer at KASB & Co said.
He said there were some signs of liquidity towards the end of the day but a number of banks approached the State (central) Bank of Pakistan to square their positions.
He said an inflow of three billion rupees was expected on Tuesday on maturity of paper sold in an open market operation.
But the inflow was unlikely to have a significant impact on the prevaling rates as the market was short by a much larger amount, he said.
